eyebrow: A quiet corner for real feelings
heroSubtitle: Stories, photos, thoughts, and little pieces of life - kept softly in one beautiful place.
featuredQuote: Some feelings are not posted for attention. They are kept because they once made us alive.
aboutText: A place where thoughts slow down, memories breathe, and feelings find their own little sky. Here, I write the moments I could not say out loud - stories, emotions, dreams, growth, silence, and everything that made me who I am becoming.
footerText: Made with memories, softness and hope.

memories.title: The Dream She Left Behind
memories.text: Some dreams do not end when we open our eyes. There was a temple near home, a quiet river, soft sunrise, and the feeling that she was there. Everything faded when I woke up, but the dream stayed with me.

memories.title: The Day She Made Everything Beautiful
memories.text: This is not just a story. This is one of the most beautiful days of my life - the day that still lives in my heart. Some people come into your life and quietly become your favorite memory.

memories.title: A memory I wanted to keep
memories.text: Some days do not return, but their light stays somewhere inside us. This was one of those days - simple, soft, and unforgettable.

memories.title: When the heart became honest
memories.text: I did not need the world to understand everything. I only wanted a place where I could write what I felt without hiding from myself.

memories.title: A promise to myself
memories.text: Even if some stories hurt, I will keep growing. I will turn pain into discipline, memories into art, and silence into peace.

thoughts.text: Happiness is like a passing guest; sorrow is the one that stays loyal.
When people lose someone and quietly endure the pain, the world calls it maturity.
Sometimes, having a tender heart and a truthful soul feels less like a blessing, and more like a curse.
Rebirth is only a beautiful illusion, my dear.
Life doesn't work on emotional Intensity.
There is a place I must reach, but first, there is a place I must leave.
A person slowly dies when they say nothing and keep thinking everything.
Bit by bit, I am turning into stone; bit by bit, I am disappearing from myself.
Some days are not perfect, but they still teach us how to stay soft.
I am becoming someone my younger self needed.
A small memory can hold a whole season.

letters.text: Some people become a season in our life. Even when they leave, the weather remembers them.
I am learning to keep love without losing myself, and to keep memories without living inside them forever.
Not every feeling needs a reply. Some feelings only need a beautiful place to rest.
